name: project_onboarding
description: Onboard an AI employee to a project by analyzing its project document, identifying required skills and tools, researching and creating any missing capabilities, and producing a comprehensive Project Onboarding Report. Optionally accepts the role_setup output directory for context on the AI employee's existing role artifacts (role document, skills, tools, associations), and a path to additional project/team artifacts. Runs a nested breakdown-then-aggregate pipeline: outer breakdown identifies skill/tool subtasks; inner pipeline researches and synthesizes each subtask.

parameters.name: project_document_path
parameters.description: Path to the project description document (Markdown). E.g. './projects/backend_service.md'.

parameters.name: --role-setup-path
parameters.description: Path to the role_setup output directory containing pre-onboarding role artifacts: role document, existing skills (skills/), tools (tools/), role-tool association (role_tool_association.json), and role setup report. Provides context on the AI employee's existing capabilities so the breakdown can focus on project-specific gaps.

parameters.name: --artifacts-path
parameters.description: Path to a directory containing additional project/team artifacts (READMEs, architecture docs, team norms, onboarding guides) the breakdown agent can scan for context.

parameters.name: --max-facets
parameters.description: Maximum number of outer onboarding subtasks to break the project into.

parameters.name: --max-inner-facets
parameters.description: Maximum number of inner research subtasks per outer onboarding subtask.

returns: A Project Onboarding Report (project_onboarding_report.md) covering: existing tools associated to project needs, new tools/skills created, workflow mappings, gaps, and an onboarding checklist.
